title: How Coding Errors Reach Patients
description: Trace the path from a wrong or missing code through the record, decision support, and a clinician's judgment, to find every point where the chain could have been broken before it reached a patient.

title: Running a Safety Audit
description: Design and run an audit scoped to actually finish, sampled to find harm rather than reassurance, with severities people agree on and evidence that survives a challenge.

title: Writing Findings Two Audiences Can Act On
description: Write a finding a clinician and an engineer can both understand and act on without a meeting — clinical impact and technical cause in the same paragraph, reproducible, correctly urgent.

title: Getting the System Fixed
description: Turn a correct, well-written finding into an actual change in a pipeline, a workflow, or a policy — including when the fix belongs to a vendor and verifying it actually worked.

title: Governance and Regulation
description: Know the regulatory frame around clinical AI well enough to work inside it, ask the right questions before a pipeline goes live, and understand what evidence and reporting obligations actually apply.
